mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, it is 76 degrees out at Badger Prairie County Park. We are looking at a clear night with a Waxing Gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible at 3:24 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Fitchburg while reaching halfway up the sky. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is currently hiring an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction and utility projects, with a deadline to apply on September 20, 2026. Also, remember that the city offers a rain barrel rebate program to help manage stormwater, providing a 30 dollar credit for qualifying barrel installations.

There is plenty to do, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, Girls Try Hockey tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena, and yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday.
In a report covering last week, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I on Friday, August 15, after she was found asleep in her vehicle at an intersection.

Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Raspberry Cheesecake and they are open until 10:30 PM tonight. You can also enjoy a treat at the Kona Ice truck located at Fireman's Park today between 11 AM and 5 PM.
